name: Ashwall Broker's Complete Underworld Set
description:
A fixer's full look built for rooms where everyone is armed: charcoal-grey structured longcoat in water-resistant silk-analog over a collarless black tunic and slim charcoal trousers with concealed thigh channels for chrome leg rigs. Soft leather-analog ankle boots with silent soles. Hands bare or gloved in Ashwall's signature grip-null secondskin. A low-profile neural port cover sits flush at the temple — polished gunmetal, not hidden, just understated. No insignia. No brand marks visible.

Every seam is hand-finished. The coat's inner lining contains eight concealed pockets, two of which are signal-shielded for device storage. Tail slit runs the full back length of the coat.
functionality: Eight inner concealed pockets (two signal-shielded), chrome leg channel seams, tail slit, silent-sole boots, flush neural port cover, no visible brand identification.
what_it_says: Whoever this is, they operate in spaces that don't officially exist — and they've been doing it long enough to afford good clothes.
story_hooks: One of the signal-shielded pockets contains a device that hasn't been powered on in three years — and someone very dangerous wants to know why it went dark.
The coat was tailored for someone else; the original owner's name is stitched in faded thread inside the collar, half-unpicked.
A Tier 5 exec keeps requesting meetings with whoever wears this coat, through intermediaries, always anonymously.

physical_description.visual_profile: A fixer's silhouette: sharp, controlled, predatory. The long structured coat creates vertical lines that elongate the frame while the slim trousers ground the look in precision. The open front reveals the collarless tunic underneath—no unnecessary neckwear to catch or constrain. Temple-mounted neural port cover gleams subtly. Overall impression is calculated threat wrapped in tailored restraint.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not tight. The longcoat is structured with intelligent drape—it moves with the body without clinging. Trousers are slim through the hip and thigh (accommodating the concealed chrome rig channels) but break cleanly at the ankle. Tunic sits loose enough for layered augmentation but never baggy. Boots are snug but designed for silent mobility.
physical_description.primary_material: Water-resistant silk-analog (coat outer), ballistic-weave cotton blend (tunic), wool-composite (trousers), soft leather-analog (boots), secondskin synthetic grip-null (gloves optional)
physical_description.texture: Smooth, deliberate. The silk-analog has subtle sheen without gloss. Inner lining is densely woven, almost noiseless. Leather-analog is buttery soft with micro-grip soles. Secondskin gloves have almost-invisible traction ridges on palms. Every surface is engineered to move without sound.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey (coat, trousers) with pure black (tunic). Gunmetal temple port cover. Soft grey-brown leather boots. No accent colors—the restraint IS the statement.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap fasteners down the coat front (silent, secure, fast-draw accessible). Friction-fit inner pocket flaps. Thigh channels have discreet magnetic seals for rig security. Boots feature hidden magnetic side clasps.
distinctive_features: Eight concealed inner pockets with hand-finished edges
Full-length back slit for seated mobility and weapon access
Polished gunmetal neural port cover (flush-mounted, not camouflaged—shows confidence)
Hand-finished seams throughout (marks of legitimate Ashwall craftsmanship)
Thigh channels pre-fitted for chrome leg rig mounting
Secondskin grip-null gloves (bare hands also acceptable—gloves signal caution)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 boundary. Too refined and purposeful for street-level tier 5, but not the flashy chrome and logo-saturation of tier 1 corpo elite. This is working-class affluence—someone who earns enough to commission bespoke tailoring.
physical_description.cultural_context: Fixer. Broker. Negotiator in dangerous spaces. Someone who moves between corpo boardrooms and black-market chop shops without belonging entirely to either. The look says: 'I am armed, I am augmented, I am professional, and I respect you enough not to make it obvious.' No gang colors, no corporate brand loyalty, no street salvage aesthetic. Pure neutrality.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new (Ashwall commissions start at 8,000Φ). Quickly becomes 'broken-in'—subtle creasing at the joints, maybe a small scar on the coat from a close call, but never truly worn-out. This is maintained gear.
